chunks: Indeed you will come to know soon.

key_terms.سَوْفَ: A particle indicating future tense, often implying nearness or certainty.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Sawfa ta'lamun' in Surah Al-Takathur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a promise of immediate reckoning or a specific event (such as the Day of Judgment or the appearance of the Imam) where the illusion of worldly accumulation will be shattered. It serves as a spiritual corrective, urging believers to prioritize eternal gains over the transient 'competition' (takathur) that distracts from divine remembrance.
